relTest.notes: New Settings → Tools section: roof pitch, angle and level, and USB cameras in one place. Roof pitch now shows as a roof gauge on the camera (needle on the pitch and degrees scales; switch to numbers only in Tools). New: calibrate roof pitch against a certified roof gauge at 2 or more known pitches (0:12, 1:12, 4:12, 7:12, 12:12), with before/after accuracy, gauge serial, optional calibration line in the notes file and a recalibration reminder. Calibration stays on each phone.
